SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS doy_bucket, cls,
  SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy>=300
  AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','three_quarter','full_day','overnight','day_1_5','twilight')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
